Genuine transparent alpha, no text, numbers, cell borders, shadows outside objects, particles or background. Every ROW is one different building transformation of the SAME legless heavy unit in reference 1. Reference 2 is a strip of five exact targets left-to-right: STORAGE (row1), EVOLUTION LAB (row2), OUTPOST (row3), WATCHPOST (row4), BARRIER (row5). Keep the exact species palette, mouthless dot-eye face, camera and soft painted game material from ref1. These are ACTION-DEFINING KEY DRAWINGS for full frame animation. Each row columns: 0 exact legless neutral; 1 anticipation, closed eyes and low compressed broad body; 2 body physically grows toward that specific structure; 3 unmistakable half-formed structure, remaining body tissue continuously connected; 4 almost-complete structure, small folds/details still forming; 5 exact corresponding target from ref2. Source creature is roughly one tile, storage/lab two, outpost three, tower/barrier one; intentional growth with consistent material thickness. Eyes close early and stay closed until face creases become structural folds; no open eyes reappearing. ALL early unit poses have ONE continuous underside: NO legs, toes, knees, isolated pads or body gap. Architectural foundations may form late. Every pose is one connected organism, no detached roof, slices, dissolves, featureless cocoon or generic blob. Row1 storage: lower-body opening grows upward into a continuous arch, roof unfolds from crown, cargo buds form inside late. Row2 lab: torso rises/curls into the specific chamber around its central evolution core, supports grow from tissue, use target 2. Row3 outpost: lower body spreads into the target's broad brood cradle/nest and canopy around eggs, target 3. Row4 watchpost: body COMPRESSES NARROW and EXTRUDES UP into the slender solid support; crown becomes the small lookout/top, target 4. Never a hollow house or arch. Row5 barrier: body FLATTENS AND SPREADS as a SOLID low connected barricade, target 5. No door, room, arch or hollow. The body becomes each structure, not sitting beside it. All sprites fully visible with clean gaps. Respect each target's exact materials and silhouette.
Cream mushroom tissue becomes attached walls/supports; red cap unfolds or compresses into correct cap structures. Match each target's number of caps and pearl/egg/core details. No unit legs.
